bullets: Utilized app-scanning technologies including Wiz, Black Duck, Tenable, and Harbor to support SAST, SCA, and CSPM assessments for core engineering products.
Configured web applications for secure authentication flows, integrating programmatic user provisioning features using the Okta API as the identity source.
Collaborated with product owners to define security KPIs, writing backend code to generate multi-dimensional tracking matrices that map technical metrics directly to business risks.
Partnered with Internal Audit teams to execute data control checks, programmatically exporting vulnerability history trends and structural reports required for SOC 2 and ISO compliance reviews.
Authored technical customer-facing security advisories, remediation guides, and internal knowledge base articles covering software vulnerabilities and secure coding practices.
